svg.title: Navarra study map
svg.desc: Orientation map with representative study locations and selected rivers and towns. Country and state outlines are geographic context, not appellation boundaries. No vineyard parcels or elevation model are implied. 1: Navarra; 2: Estella-Lizarra; 3: Puente la Reina; 4: Tudela; 5: San Martín de Unx; 6: Metauten; 7: Lorca; 8: Pamplona; 9: Logroño; 10: Vitoria

g.title: 5 · San Martín de Unx: representative location

g.text: Light markers: study locations · dark markers: geographic context · teal: water

text.tspan: Follow the land. Compare the wines.
Open this map in the Codex for terroir, grapes, growing, cellar
choices and service. Dots locate places; they do not define a wine
